company.name: KhelClan
company.mission: Empowering athletes through innovation and convenience.

culture: Community First: Everything we do is to bring people together.
Innovation: We automate the highlight-capturing experience using AI-driven cameras.
Accessibility: Our goal is to make premium sports venues available to every amateur athlete.
Passion for Sport: The team behind KhelClan consists of actual athletes who play the games they host.
rules: Players must arrive at least 15 minutes before their booked slot.
Cancellation is allowed up to 2 hours before the start time for a 90% refund.
Appropriate sports shoes (turf shoes or studs for football) are required.
Usage of plastic whistles or loud airhorns is prohibited to respect neighboring residents.

faq.q: How do I get my highlights?
faq.a: Highlights are automatically processed and delivered to your KhelClan dashboard within 30 minutes of the game's end.
Yes! You can share your booking link with friends so they can join the slot directly or see the game details.
